history.summary: Freehold D13 3BR at $1,494 psf, ~5% below the $1,580 median, in a small boutique development near Woodleigh. PSF looks cheap because the 1,539 sqft unit is oversized for a 3BR, and the 6.88%/yr URA rate rests on only 6 transactions, so it is statistically unreliable.
history.rating_rationale: $2.3M entry sits in the broad-buyer band and freehold D13 near NEL/Woodleigh has decent fundamentals, but 1,539 sqft inflates the absolute price for a 3BR and dampens PSF appeal — exit pricing is set by quantum, not the optically-low PSF. 6-txn appreciation series cannot be trusted; boutique block means thin liquidity. Balanced positives and concerns.
red_flags: Only 6 URA transactions — appreciation rate unreliable
Oversized 1,539 sqft 3BR inflates quantum and depresses PSF optics
catalysts: Freehold tenure in maturing D13 Woodleigh/Bidadari corridor
